_comment: Copy this to configs/line.json and fill it in. That file is gitignored. Environment variables TELEMETRY_OCR_LINE_TOKEN and TELEMETRY_OCR_LINE_TO take precedence and never touch the disk.
_setup: Since 4 Sep 2024 a Messaging API channel cannot be created in the LINE Developers Console. Create a LINE Official Account at manager.line.biz, then Settings -> Messaging API -> enable. The channel appears in developers.line.biz/console afterwards.
_token: LINE Developers Console -> your channel -> Messaging API tab -> Channel access token (long-lived)
_to: The user, group or room id to push to. A user id starts with U, a group id with C. It is NOT the LINE display name or the @handle of the Official Account.
_public_base_url: OPTIONAL. Leave empty to send telemetry as text only, which exposes nothing. Set it to a Cloudflare Tunnel hostname (see scripts/setup_cloudflare_tunnel.ps1) to also send the captured picture. Doing so puts that frame within reach of anyone holding the URL while it lives, and LINE keeps its own copy afterwards.
